Bounding boxes contain background; rings exclude known annotated boxes only. Measurements use aspect-preserving bounded grayscale thumbnails; tiny crops have undefined detail proxies. High-frequency residuals mix texture and noise; Laplacian variance mixes sharpness and noise. Low brightness is not night, high entropy is not difficulty, contrast is not semantic visibility. Candidate ranks are relative to the inspected sample; no detection probability or calibrated confidence interval.

Bounding boxes contain background; rings exclude known annotated boxes only. Measurements use aspect-preserving bounded grayscale thumbnails; tiny crops have undefined detail proxies. High-frequency residuals mix texture and noise; Laplacian variance mixes sharpness and noise. Low brightness is not night, high entropy is not difficulty, contrast is not semantic visibility. Candidate ranks are relative to the inspected sample; no detection probability or calibrated confidence interval.

Limitations and risks

  • disabled
  • No universal training sample minimum exists; supply scenario minimum_samples or an explicit count requirement
  • No reference dataset supplied; diversity alone does not establish representativeness
  • Required evidence column is unavailable: unspecified
  • Near-duplicate analysis is disabled
  • Preprocessing pipeline metadata is absent
  • Supply recorded weather metadata (column weather) or an explicitly configured local classifier where supported.
  • Recorded timestamps or time_of_day metadata required; appearance is not capture time.
  • Supply declared seasons, or recorded timestamps and explicit north/south hemisphere for meteorological seasons.
  • Supply recorded scene metadata (column scene) or an explicitly configured local classifier where supported.
  • Supply viewpoint categories or calibrated camera_pitch metadata with explicit angular units.
  • Flight altitude column and explicit unit/datum metadata required; apparent object scale is not altitude.
  • Configure a local visual encoder; valid crop embeddings and model/version are required. No model is downloaded.
  • Occlusion annotations are absent; missing values are not zero occlusion.
  • Conditional coverage is descriptive; deployment representativeness requires an explicit meaningful reference.
  • Declare sensor_types mappings, units, and calibration/alignment evidence for relevant modalities.
  • READY means the confirmed, measurable requirements passed; it does not establish model accuracy, sufficient training size, or deployment safety.
  • Statistical outliers are not classified as corruption without declared valid ranges or platform specifications.
  • Annotation completeness inside an image and true object-label correctness are unverified without independent audit.
  • Dataset metadata and reference relevance are user-declared; their authenticity is not independently verified.
  • Exact repeated observations were detected; their legitimacy and effect on effective sample size require review.
